title_ar: وفد من قيادة المقاومة الإسلامية يقدم تهنئة العيد لفضيلة الشيخ في محل إقامته
title_en: A Delegation from the Leadership of the Islamic Resistance Presents Eid Greetings to His Eminence the Sheikh at His Residence
body_ar:
أدى مساء اليوم الثلاثاء 20يوليو 2021 م وفد من المكتب السياسي لحركة المقاومة الإسلامية حماس زيارة لفضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في محل إقامته في الدوحة، و ضم الوفد كلا من القائد اسماعيل هنية رئيس المكتب السياسي للحركة و د.خليل إسماعيل إبراهيم الحية

و استقبل فضيلة الشيخ ضيوفه الكرام بما هم أهل له، شاكرا جهودهم في الدفاع عن أرض الإسراء و المعراج، مبينا ضرورة تضافر جهود الأمة من أجل استعادة أرض المسلمين و تحرير أوطانهم؛

الوفد الكريم من جهته أعرب لفضيلة الشيخ عن امتنانه للشعب الموريتاني على حفاوة الاستقبال و كرم الضيافة، مثمنا مواقف الموريتانيين الثابتة من القضية الفلسطينية،

كما تناول الوفد الكريم دور العلماء و جهودهم في توعية الأمة و تعريفها بقضيتها الأولى، خاصة في هذه الظرفية التي يبذل فيها المحتل و أعوانه أموالا طائلة لتشويه المقا ومة و رموزها و ترويج فكرة التطبيع السياسي و الثقافي و الديني .
body_en:
On the evening of today, Tuesday 20 July 2021, a delegation from the political bureau of the Islamic Resistance Movement, Hamas, paid a visit to His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew at his residence in Doha. The delegation included the leader Ismail Haniyeh, head of the movement's political bureau, and Dr Khalil Ismail Ibrahim al-Hayya.

His Eminence the Sheikh received his honoured guests in the manner due to them, thanking them for their efforts in defending the land of the Night Journey and the Ascension, and setting out the need for the efforts of the Ummah to be joined together so that the Muslims' land may be recovered and their homelands freed.

The honoured delegation for its part expressed to His Eminence the Sheikh its gratitude to the Mauritanian people for the warmth of their reception and the generosity of their hospitality, and valued the Mauritanians' steadfast positions on the Palestinian cause.

The honoured delegation also addressed the role of the scholars and their efforts in making the Ummah aware of its foremost cause and acquainting it with it, particularly in these circumstances, in which the occupier and his helpers expend vast sums to tarnish the resistance and its figures and to promote the idea of political, cultural and religious normalisation.

flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW, highest exposure in this slice. Hamas is a proscribed or designated organisation in the United Kingdom, the European Union, the United States and elsewhere. This record reports a meeting with its political bureau leadership, names its head, and reports the Sheikh thanking them for their efforts and calling for the Muslims' land to be recovered. Published in English on a UK/EU-facing site, the page could be read as supportive material relating to a proscribed organisation, which is a criminal-law question, not an editorial one. The translation is faithful and has been neither softened nor strengthened: جهودهم في الدفاع is 'their efforts in defending', تحرير أوطانهم is 'free their homelands', and nothing has been added. The publication decision belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office, with legal advice, and must never be taken by default.

translator_notes: A news report of a visit. It reports no ruling and engages no legal category, so the five-rulings mapping of style guide section 3 is not in play.
أرض الإسراء و المعراج, 'the land of the Night Journey and the Ascension', is the conventional reference to Jerusalem and al-Aqsa; rendered literally rather than replaced with the place name.
الأمة is kept as 'the Ummah', the established English for the worldwide Muslim community.
The body's own internal date, Tuesday 20 July 2021, agrees with the CMS timestamp, so for this record the date is corroborated by the text even though the stamp itself is CMS-generated.
Source defect, recorded not fixed: المقا ومة appears with a stray space inside the word (for المقاومة). body_ar preserves it.

The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload/publication stamp, not the date on which the Sheikh gave the answer. Records across this range carry timestamps clustered minutes apart on the same day (e.g. 1275-1278 at 09:51/09:53/09:54/09:55 on 7 March 2022), which is the signature of a batch upload. date_is_cms_upload is therefore set true throughout.
dec: Reports a meeting with the political bureau leadership of Hamas and names its head. Hamas is proscribed in the UK and the EU; this is a criminal-law question, not an editorial one.
